identity.name: AWEN01.cc
identity.tagline: Old wisdom for the coming world.
identity.mission: AWEN01 is a creative collective making music, visionary art, visionary writing, and wisdom work for a culture being transformed by technology. We bridge old druidic ways and the spiritual lineage of the fae into the new world with heart, imagination, and disciplined beauty.

dos: Use the mark with generous clearspace, at least the height of the inner glyph around all sides.
Place the logo on deep labradorite, moon white, or neutral threshold grey backgrounds.
Let the logo breathe. It should feel like a sigil, not an app icon.
donts: Do not add neon glows, drop shadows, bevels, or extra gradients to the logo.
Do not place the logo over busy AI imagery or dense node fields.
Do not stretch, rotate, outline, or recolor the mark outside approved palette tokens.

typography.notes: Use Jost 300 for body, metadata, captions, and atmospheric phrases. Use Jost 700 for headings, section labels, navigation, and CTAs. Display type should be large but spacious, never cramped.

spacing.notes: Use an 8px grid. Let immersive sections breathe with larger intervals. Keep UI controls tighter and exact.

principles: Compose pages as threshold sequences: dark immersion, light clarity, muted integration.
Use low-poly node fields as background atmosphere, never behind small body text.
Keep the first viewport focused on one message and one primary action.
Treat whitespace as ceremony: generous, calm, and intentional.

context.intro: AWEN01 appears across music releases, essays, artwork, rituals, digital products, and community portals. The system should scale from album-art atmosphere to sober editorial guidance. Motion is part of the identity: aurora fields and living node matrices are approved motif systems when used with restraint.

motion.principle: Motion is a brand motif, not decoration. It should feel like old starlore meeting living signal.
motion.implementation: UltraBGs owns animated backgrounds. AWEN01 supplies brand presets, editor classes, and usage standards.

aurora_borealis.usage: Use on immersive dark and threshold sections. Keep the gradient slow, soft, and text-safe.
aurora_borealis.reduced_motion: Freeze at a calm gradient state when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

low_poly_node_matrix.usage: Use as sparse connective tissue behind hero, music, writing, and portal sections. Never place dense nodes under body copy.
low_poly_node_matrix.behavior: Nodes pulse, drift, and morph between triangular connections like a star map or mycelial network.
low_poly_node_matrix.density: 18-54 nodes depending on section size, low opacity, wide spacing.
low_poly_node_matrix.reduced_motion: Render a static, low-opacity node field.

wordpress_editing.instructions: Use the UltraBGs panel on GenerateBlocks containers. For layered AWEN sections, use awenaurora on the main section and awennodes on an absolute child overlay. Keep AWEN brand classes for readability.

imagery.style: Opalescent natural intelligence: aurora gradients, labradorite mineral light, misty forest thresholds, sparse node matrices, low-poly constellations, handwritten wisdom fragments, and luminous sound-wave forms. Imagery should feel ceremonial and technologically aware, not psychedelic clutter.
dos: Use slow aurora gradients and mineral color shifts as atmosphere.
Combine old-world organic forms with precise digital geometry.
Preserve dark negative space for type and navigation.
Use muted light-mode imagery for reading surfaces.
donts: Do not use generic fantasy castles, neon hacker code, or busy rainbow gradients.
Do not use AI-generated people as proof of real community.
Do not place small text over high-frequency texture.
Do not let motion overpower reading.
imagery.treatments: Aurora overlays should be low opacity and slow, moving like realistic borealis light across labradorite. Low-poly node matrices should use fine linework with circle nodes, pulsing like a star map, mycelial signal field, or living constellation. Use UltraBGs packs `awenaurora` and `awennodes` on GenerateBlocks containers, retaining `awen-aurora` and `awen-node-matrix` as readable brand classes. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

tone.guidelines: Speak as a guide at a threshold. Use mythic language only when it clarifies the feeling. Balance wonder with concrete action. Prefer short, resonant sentences over abstract spiritual fog.
